secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare account ID — found in the Cloudflare dashboard (right sidebar on any zone page, or Workers & Pages > Overview). Needed for Workers AI access during local dev.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permission — create at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens (use the 'Edit Workers AI' template or a custom token including Workers AI:Read). Needed for the chat to get AI responses.
